title: Home planting guide for this week: a pot, compost or soil, a seed (cress, bean or sunflower) or a bulb; plant with an adult and photograph each step
subject: English
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 68 (Home planting guide for this week: a pot, compost or soil, a seed (cress, bean or sunflower) or a bulb; plant with an adult and photograph each step)
intro: Lesson 68: Researching how to plant a seed, bulb or small plant. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To plant a seed or bulb and follow written instructions
equipment: A small pot with a hole in the bottom
A seed (cress, bean or sunflower) or a bulb
safety: Wash your hands after touching soil
Do not eat seeds or bulbs
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: With an adult, fill the pot with compost to 2 cm below the top
Make a hole about twice as deep as the seed (about 2 cm for a bean); a bulb goes in pointed end up
Put in the seed or bulb and cover it gently
Water gently so the seed is not washed away; do not flood it
Stand the pot on the saucer in a warm, bright place or a sunny windowsill
Photograph each step and check every day: shoots usually appear in 7 to 14 days
